scoring_justification: The paper-reported Debye temperature cannot be exactly recomputed from the rounded public input data (off by ~2.9 K), so the checker compares the agent's output to the paper's gold with tolerances that accommodate the rounding discrepancy, while strict tolerances are applied to the exactly reproducible elastic moduli.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for elastic moduli and Debye temperature from Table 1 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (values extracted from the paper text)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual transcription from the paper's published results
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly the paper-reported quantities; no synthetic or arbitrary data.

outputs.description: Computed elastic moduli and Debye temperature for each composition. The checker compares these values against the paper's reported gold values within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The task is restricted to the stationary elastic moduli and Debye temperature at T=20°C. All other stages of the paper (temperature-dependent derivatives, overvolume, optical Kramers-Kronig analysis, Fulcher viscosity fitting) are excluded because they rely on non-public or non-computable inputs.
